title: Spicy Kielbasa Tagine
description: A hearty and aromatic Moroccan-inspired stew featuring spicy kielbasa and a blend of warming spices.
instructions: Heat the oil in the bottom of a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the bell pepper and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the kielbasa and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomatoes, broth, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with parsley if desired.
